title: Home Purchase Agreement Status, Construction Stages and Closing: Training Questions
content:
**Q. What statuses does a Home Purchase Agreement pass through?**
An agreement is written pending ratification. It becomes ratified when the deposits due at signing have posted and Calloway countersigns, or is cancelled by the system when they do not post in time. A ratified agreement moves to under construction when the foundation is started, or, on a completed inventory home, straight to closing scheduled when the closing date is set. A to-be-built home moves from under construction to closing scheduled when the closing date is set. It ends as closed when the sale funds and records, as cancelled when the buyer confirms a cancellation request, or as terminated when Calloway terminates for an uncured buyer default.

**Q. When does construction start, and in what order are stages recorded?**
Construction starts only on a ratified agreement, and the system records each stage in the order not started, foundation, framing, drywall, finishes, complete.

**Q. When may the closing date be set?**
On an inventory home once the agreement is ratified; on a to-be-built home once the construction stage is finishes or complete.

**Q. When does the agreement close?**
Only when the construction stage is complete, every deposit due has posted, and the buyer's loan has funded (or cash has been received). Closing is written only when the construction stage is complete; the stage is read from the agreement record.

**Q. What happens to money at closing?**
Every deposit held is credited to the buyer, every unwaived charge is collected, and incentives are applied under the agreement's incentive terms.

**Q. What must a new agreement's price look like?**
The contract price on a new agreement must equal the base price plus the lot premium, and the base price must sit within the collection's lowest and highest base price.

**Check yourself (hypothetical).**

| Agreement | Stage | Closing date may be set? | Closing may be written? |
|---|---|---|---|
| To-be-built, under construction | Drywall | No | No |
| To-be-built, under construction | Finishes | Yes | No |
| To-be-built, closing scheduled | Complete | — | Yes, once every deposit due has posted and the loan has funded or cash is received |
| Inventory home, ratified | Complete | Yes | — |

A new agreement with a hypothetical base price of 400000.00 and a lot premium of 12000.00 must carry a contract price of 412000.00.
